title: An expansion week on a real chart
frame: ES futures, daily bars, two weeks, Mon 31 Mar 2025 to Fri 11 Apr 2025

steps.title: Last week's low
steps.caption: The week of Mon 31 Mar 2025 made its low at 5,074.00. The sell stops under that low are where the new week looks first.

steps.title: The low forms early
steps.caption: Mon 7 Apr ran below it to 4,832.00 and closed at 5,097.25. The low of the week was in by Monday.

steps.title: Expansion
steps.caption: The week then expanded: the high, 5,528.75, printed on Thu, and the week closed at 5,391.25, in the top 20% of its 696.75-point range.

steps.title: The weekly candle
steps.caption: Open 5,007.00, low 4,832.00, high 5,528.75, close 5,391.25: a bullish weekly candle whose wick was the early-week sweep of last week's low. Lesson 22's shape, on real daily bars.
